_comment: Single source of truth for the VIP store. Prices in cents. To add a product: copy a block in 'products', give it a unique id, put images in public/vipstore/img/. Set 'active': false to hide one. One-size items: use "sizes": { "One size": 10 }. Update stock by hand after each sale until the Stripe webhook is in place.
